title: Finite etale splitting of generic components of a finite type family
statement: Let $T$ be an integral Noetherian scheme [def-pc-integral-scheme, pqf-def-locnoeth], where Noetherian means locally Noetherian and quasi-compact, let $f:X\to T$ be a finite type morphism [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and use scheme-theoretic fibres [def-pc-scheme-fibre]. There exist a nonempty affine open $U\subseteq T$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], an integral affine scheme $S$, and a finite etale surjective morphism $\pi:S\to U$ [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-weil-etale-morphism, def-weil-surjective-morphism] such that, writing $\xi$ for the generic point of $S$ [def-sc-generic-point], every irreducible component of $(X\times_T S)_\xi$ [def-pc-fibre-product, def-weil-irreducible-components] is geometrically irreducible over $\kappa(\xi)$ [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible, def-weil-residue-field]. Geometric irreducibility means that its inverse image is irreducible and nonempty after every field extension. No properness, flatness, reducedness or dimension assumption on $X/T$ is imposed; the generic fibre may be empty.
